title: Langchain Slides & Overview
description: LangChain is a framework designed to make building applications powered by large language models (LLMs) easier. It provides a set of tools and libraries that simplify the process, allowing developers to focus on the core functionality of their application without getting bogged down in the complexities of working with LLMs directly. <br/> <br/>Here's a quick breakdown of LangChain's key features: <br/> <br/>Modular building blocks: LangChain offers pre-built components that handle common LLM interactions, like calling the LLM and interpreting the response. This saves developers time and effort compared to building everything from scratch. <br/>Integration with various LLMs: LangChain can work with different large language models, including ChatGPT and others. <br/>Focus on application development: By handling the LLM interaction details, LangChain lets developers concentrate on building the core logic and user interface of their application. <br/>Open-source and community-driven: LangChain is freely available and benefits from a growing community of developers who contribute improvements and extensions.
